triplet: The Babyface, high-flying moves, because audiences cheer: a slave to approval.
The Heel: bear hugs, eye pokes. If they aren't booing, you aren't doing your job.
The Tweener: you don't ask for it, which makes them want you more.
The Jobber, isolated and picked apart. You exist to make the other guy look good.
The Immovable Object, slow gorilla, strong enough to hurl you like a ragdoll.
The Aerial Ace, agile and fast: if you stand still, you die.
The Powerhouse Botch off the top rope: a tragedy waiting to happen.
The Little Giant: smaller, surprising strength.
The Master Seller: reel back, limp to the ring, make them believe.
The No-Sell Monster sits right back up: remove all tension for ego.
The Thigh Slap didn't hurt, but it sounds like it did. An audio lie.
The Echo Chest: loud noise, but it requires many strikes to actually bruise.
The Chop Fest: nothing but chop, until one quits. A test of endurance.
The Sacred Mask, sacred to identity: never remove it.
The Rudo Ripper: instant disqualification, but you win the feud.
The Limp Arm: rejection of the traditional start, a telltale sign of a shooter.
The Juice Lover: you can't hurt me if I hurt me first.
The Snake Bag has a live snake: terrify them before the match starts.
The Lazy Genius, hands in pockets. It looks like a chore, and the apathy makes them furious.
The Exotic: dignity rather than body. Psychological dominance.
The Hot Tag: fresh partner for payback, the explosive release of tension.
The Victim, isolated and picked apart: you are the bait.
The Wolfpack: triple attack on an isolated target. The numbers game.
The Savant Manager: you know the moves better than they do.
The Pop Hunter: if they want a heel, give them a heel. If they want a clown, honk your nose.
The Empty Arena, pausing for a pop that never comes: silence amplifies the sound of impacts.
The Green Screen Crowd: a failed attempt to hide the emptiness.
The Plant: I'm just a fan! Gambling on the outcome while part of the show.
The Shooter: if you refuse to sell, real damage.
The Real Injury, unplanned. The crowd goes nuts because it's real.
The Undead Wizard: get under their skin with smoke and mirrors.
The Finger Poke: a test of strength? No, a test of gullibility.
The Finisher, the Leg Drop: if this hits, go home.
The False Finish: the art of the near-fall.
The Squash: total dominance.
The Time Limit Draw: no winner, both keep their dignity.
The Booker: the ending is pre-planned. You are just a puppet.
The Ring Post, unforgiving steel: the hardest object in the building.
The Hard Cam: if the camera didn't see it, it didn't happen.
The Internet Smark, talking about psychology without ever taking a bump.
The Kayfabe Police: keep the secrets secret, or get fired.
The Retirement Match: rising, and falling. See you next season.
